impact.resources: Same staging API and 10 existing collectors; only the 59 already-pending Yuyu discovery scopes become consumable. No new resources/scopes, schedules, service variables, budget limit or concurrency changes.
impact.routes: No new API/product routes. Restore listing evidence -> candidate -> pending proposal -> fenced checkpoint integration. Preserve exact CardPrint, approval and sale semantics.
impact.dependencies: Existing PostgreSQL queue/admission, Playwright source listing parser and pure proposal resolver; no packages or schema migration.
impact.deployment_impact: At most 10 uploads, 20 builds and 30 deployment records including native Git and recognized watch-path snapshot redeploys. No services or deployment-trigger changes. Existing work bound 8 includes discovery.

recovery.procedure: Restore the recorded exact prior collector deployment snapshots and prior API source on the same pinned staging services. Preserve SNKRDUNK pause, mappings/quarantines and immutable history. No rollback database writes.
recovery.trigger: Wrong destination/identity, integrity risk, duplicate requests, required source denial or bounded rollout failure: contain the affected source and restore prior source snapshot.
recovery.backup: Retained exact Git source and per-service prior deployment IDs; archive checksum is recorded in preflight. No migration or irreversible mapping operation.

verification.observation_window: Verify exact runtime revision and subsequent unchanged scheduled collector executions. Discovery retains its existing due time; do not manually trigger it or accelerate due dates. Stop expansion on a real current source-health/exact-identity evidence constraint.
